notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
notes: You can use any self-sacrificing artifact, such as Food or Clue tokens, in place of the Treasure to start. Depending on the token used, you may need additional mana or other pre-requisites.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with between three and seven loyalty counters

description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library, put them into your graveyard, and create four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{W}{B}.
Mayhem Devil triggers four times, dealing enough damage to Dihada to cause it to be put into your graveyard, and dealing the remainder of the damage to any target(s).
Cast Dihada from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R}{W}{B} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.

feature.name: Each opponent sacrifices all permanents they control

notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Silverclad Ferocidons indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Silverclad Ferocidons.
description:
Give Silverclad Ferocidons indestructible, if needed, then deal any amount of damage to it.
Silverclad Ferocidons triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a permanent.
Mayhem Devil triggers for each permanent sacrificed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Silverclad Ferocidons.
Repeat from step 2 until no opponent controls a permanent.
Resolve all remaining Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing that much damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.

notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of Treasure tokens greater than the indestructible creature's toughness.
description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate a Treasure token by sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to the indestructible creature.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 2.
